Here followe the names of the chiefest partes of man, and other wordes necessarie to be knowen.

book.title: A shorte and briefe narration of the two nauigations and discoueries to the northweast partes called Newe Fraunce: first translated out of French into Italian, by that famous learned man Gio: Bapt: Ramutius, and now turned into English by Iohn Florio; worthy the reading of all venturers, trauellers, and discouerers
book.author: Jacques Cartier, trans. John Florio

scan.rights: Public domain scan; image via Internet Archive
